name: Phone Country Flag for FormCraft
author: Kanani Parth

sections.description:
Phone Country Flag for FormCraft enhances FormCraft form fields by adding an interactive international country flag dropdown, dial code selector, and visitor country code auto-detection.

It turns standard text or number fields in FormCraft into smart, user-friendly international phone inputs powered by the industry-standard intl-tel-input library.

Key Features

  • Direct Custom Field Class Support: Simply assign your chosen CSS class (phone-country-flag or fcpf-phone-flag) to any field inside FormCraft’s field settings to instantly enable the country flag dropdown on that specific field.
  • Automatic Visitor Country Detection: Detects the visitor’s country using browser-based GeoIP lookup (cached in the browser to reduce network requests).
  • Smart Keyword Matching: Automatically discovers phone fields across your forms based on common keywords (e.g., mobile, phone, whatsapp, contact, tel).
  • Real-Time Phone Validation: Validates international phone formats on blur and input change, displaying friendly custom error messages when an invalid number is entered.
  • Preferred & Restrictive Countries: Pin key countries to the top of the dropdown list or restrict the selector to only accept specific countries.
  • FormCraft Popup & AJAX Support: Seamlessly works with AJAX-submitted forms, multi-step forms, and popup modals using DOM mutation observers.
  • 100% Bundled & GDPR Friendly: All core CSS, JavaScript, and flag sprite assets are bundled locally in the plugin — no external CDN dependencies.
  • Zero Bloat & High Performance: Lightweight, asynchronous script execution with browser localStorage caching.

How to use with FormCraft

  1. Option A (Recommended) – Custom Field Class:

    • Edit your form in FormCraft.
    • Click on the phone/mobile field to open its Field Options.
    • Under Extra Classes (or Custom CSS Class), enter phone-country-flag (or your custom class defined in plugin settings).
    • Save the form. The field will now automatically display the country flag dropdown!

  2. Option B – Automatic Detection:

    • Simply label your field with “Phone”, “Mobile”, “WhatsApp”, or “Contact Number”.
    • The plugin automatically identifies the field and attaches the flag dropdown.

  3. Option C – CSS Selector:

    • For advanced forms, enter a specific CSS selector in Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag.

Privacy Policy / Third-Party Services

This plugin provides an optional feature to automatically detect a visitor’s country code based on their IP address:

  1. ipwhois.io / ipwho.is (Primary GeoIP provider)

    • Service URL: https://ipwhois.io/
    • Terms of Service: https://ipwhois.io/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://ipwhois.io/privacy
    • Data transmitted: The visitor’s IP address is sent directly from the visitor’s browser to resolve their 2-letter country code.

  2. ipapi.co (Fallback GeoIP provider)

    • Service URL: https://ipapi.co/
    • Terms of Service: https://ipapi.co/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://ipapi.co/privacy/
    • Data transmitted: The visitor’s IP address is sent directly from the visitor’s browser if the primary provider fails.

Opt-out: Site administrators can completely disable GeoIP auto-detection at any time by unchecking “Detect visitor’s country from IP address” in Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag. When disabled, no external requests are made and the default fallback country is used instead.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the phone-country-flag-for-formcraft folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Admin Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag in your WordPress dashboard to configure your default country, preferred countries, custom field class, and validation rules.
  4. Open your FormCraft form and add the custom CSS class phone-country-flag to any phone field, or let the plugin auto-detect your fields.
sections.faq:
Does this require the FormCraft plugin?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed to seamlessly integrate with and enhance FormCraft forms (both free and premium versions).

How do I target a specific field in FormCraft?

Go to FormCraft, open your form, click on your target phone field, open Field Options, and enter phone-country-flag in the Extra Classes field. You can also customize this class name under Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag.

How does country code auto-detection work?

When enabled, the plugin checks the visitor’s country code via browser GeoIP. The result is cached in the visitor’s browser localStorage for 7 days so lookup happens only once.

Can I disable GeoIP auto-detection?

Yes. Uncheck the “Detect visitor’s country from IP address” option in Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag, and the plugin will strictly use your configured Default Country.

Are any external CDN scripts loaded?

No. All required scripts, styles, and flag images are bundled directly within the plugin to ensure fast loading times, offline support, and strict privacy compliance.

Can I restrict the dropdown to only certain countries?

Yes. In Settings > FormCraft Phone Flag, enter a comma-separated list of 2-letter ISO country codes in the “Only these countries” field (e.g., us,gb,ca,in).
